title: Better Java
description: A  Modpack that tries to enhance Minecraft with Features the Community wants.
body:
# Better Java

**Better Java** is a lightweight modpack that enhances the classic Minecraft experience without losing its vanilla feel.

## ✨ Features

* ⚒️ Improved tools, weapons, and armor (including tool trims)
* 🌍 Enhanced world generation for more variety
* 🧭 Quality-of-life improvements for smoother gameplay
* ⚡ Performance optimizations for better FPS
* 🎮 Vanilla+ style – no unnecessary or overloaded content

## 🎯 Goal

This modpack is made for players who:

* Want Minecraft to feel **better, not different**
* Prefer a simple and clean modpack
* Still want new features and improvements

## 🧩 Mod Loader

* Fabric / Quilt (depending on version)

## 📦 Status

* Currently in development

---

**Better Java** stays true to vanilla — just better.
